title: Path payment whose muxed transaction source has a muxed ID above 2^63
why: The muxed ID 15723465199396777564 does not fit a signed 64-bit integer or a double. Readers that store it as int64 get a negative number, and readers that go through a float lose the low digits, so the muxed identity is silently wrong.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger with 195 transactions; this entry's pattern is transaction 12 in apply order (position 127 in the transaction set). The same M source signs 23 transactions in ledgers 53071185-53071290 (stellar-etl#300 names operation 227939188618612737 of this ledger). The lake object was rewritten by stellar-core 23.0.1, so the Protocol 21 ledger carries TransactionMeta v4 with backfilled transfer events.

values.note: Key e5e79f8a... with muxed ID 15723465199396777564 = 0xda34f84ad842ee5c (above 2^63; as a signed int64 it would read -2723278874312774052).
The sequence number is bumped on the base account.
Every backfilled transfer event names the base G address; the muxed ID appears only in the envelope.

notes: The nine transfer movements are the backfilled consensus events of operation 0; each emitter was checked to be the Stellar Asset Contract of the named asset under the public passphrase. The source pays native through two order-book offers, XTAR through pool LA2HF..., AXLM through pool LCMR5..., and the destination receives 20611 yXLM. The stellar-etl#300 pin (muxed IDs above 2^63) is not a known divergence here because it has not been executed against this ledger.
